purpose: Limited retrospective diagnostic; no investment recommendation, broker connection or deployment eligibility
SPY_US: Excluded while the provider primary-listing flag remains unqualified; no substitution or relaxed identity rule
data_selection: Earliest 240 common complete sessions from the frozen source-check dataset, selected chronologically before any strategy outcome; preserve unused sessions
split_state: Independent cash start for each instrument/strategy/window; no holdings, optimized parameters or fitted state carried into validation/test
lookback_rule: Inside each independent window, as in the existing evaluator; no pre-window strategy execution
news_model_comparison: NOT_RUN: no attributable historical news/model/first-availability evidence supplied; never substitute invented or synthetic news for this real-data pilot

cost_assumptions.fx_application: No FX conversion/cost for evidenced USD prices and virtual USD base; no assumption about the owner's actual account

price_and_action_mapping.prices: Raw provider open/close; do not use dividend/split-adjusted close
price_and_action_mapping.volume: Provider split-adjusted volume; refuse any in-window split before replay pending a separate share-unit review
price_and_action_mapping.dividends: Historic unadjusted per-share amount and evidenced USD currency; accrue on ex-date before open, pay only after the evidenced payment date has ended in America/New_York
price_and_action_mapping.tax: Gross dividends; no withholding or personal tax model
price_and_action_mapping.calendar: Documented inferred US equity-session calendars; provider identity is not broker contract qualification

execution_model: Signals at close; hypothetical fills only at a later session open using the existing simulator. Daily volume is an ex-post capacity approximation, not evidence of executable opening liquidity or actual spreads/fills.
holdout_policy: Freeze protocol, adapter/engine and data hashes before execution. No fitting, optimization, outcome-driven selection, threshold change, repeated holdout tuning or silent retry. Preserve failures.
private_result_contents: Comparison with cash and same-instrument buy-and-hold
economic_decision: A predeclared diagnostic failure can be NO-GO. Passing diagnostics alone cannot be GO: historical availability, news/model comparison, representativeness and forward evidence remain insufficient.
storage: Ignored owner-only private local directory; no raw/provider-derived data, return series or strategy results in Git, public artifacts, app display or chat extracts
